gbm_population_evidence.quote: Suspected newly diagnosed glioblastoma according to 2021 WHO criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: BGB-58067, an MTA Cooperative PRMT5 Inhibitor

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Suspected newly diagnosed glioblastoma according to 2021 WHO criteria who have not received any tumor directed intervention other than biopsy.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: The Phase 0 secondary endpoint will be to characterize the PK of BGB-58067 in tumor tissue, plasma, and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The Phase 0 primary endpoint will be suppression of symmetric dimethylarginine (SDMA) in tumor tissue measured by immunohistochemistry (IHC).

role_evidence.quote: During Phase 2, BGB-58067 dosing will continue with standard radiation therapy (RT) followed with adjuvant therapy.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: MTA cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor in MTAP-deleted tumours
arms: Arm B: Methylated-MGMT GBM-BGB-58067 + TMZ Concurrent Therapy

role_evidence.quote: will continue BGB-58067 treatment concurrently with standard of care upfront RT and temozolomide (TMZ).

arms: Arm B: Methylated-MGMT GBM-BGB-58067 + TMZ Concurrent Therapy

source_quote.quote: Participants with unmethylated-MGMT and MTAP-deleted GBM demonstrating a positive PD response after Phase 0 surgery.

arms: Arm B: Methylated-MGMT GBM-BGB-58067 + TMZ Concurrent Therapy

source_quote.quote: Participants with unmethylated tumors will be enrolled into Arm A and participants with methylated tumors will be enrolled into Arm B.

arms: Arm B: Methylated-MGMT GBM-BGB-58067 + TMZ Concurrent Therapy

source_quote.quote: A positive PD response will be defined as a ≥ 50% decrease in SDMA expression relative to baseline biopsy tissue, if available.

coder_notes: Registered phase EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/2). MTAP deletion is in the title and defines both Phase 2 arms; coded as enrichment, matched to the PRMT5 inhibitor. A positive SDMA PD response is also required to enter Phase 2 (gating); coded as pharmacodynamic rather than eligibility. Phase 0 participants are suspected nGBM before MTAP status is known.
